malaysherasia-ai-claude-never-again-neve.description: Capture a bug or mistake as a permanent guardrail so it cannot happen twice. Use this skill whenever a bug is fixed, a test fails and is repaired, the user says "you did that again", "don't do that", "remember this", "never do X", or any correction is made that a future session would otherwise forget. Also use when the user asks to review, promote, or clean up existing lessons and hooks.
